cues: Copper pyrite has molar mass one eighty three point five, so it is thirty four point six percent copper.
The ore is only twenty percent pyrite, so it is six point nine two percent copper: sixty nine point two kilograms per tonne.
At ninety percent recovery, sixty two point three kilograms.
